_source: Story 033. Addendum enemy table: Drowned Courtier (new) 110 HP / 24 ATK / 50 posture, weak to Frost (freezes in water); swims under the surface and rises with a gold-flash slash. surface_range_m: how close the player must be before it rises; dive_after_s: time above water before it sinks again; swim_depth_m: how far under the surface it waits; freeze_in_water_s: Freeze length while it is in water (longer than the 2 s base). water_frost_buildup_mult: Frost build-up multiplier while in water, so one Frost Binding (60) freezes it.
